question: Under what prior condition may the best twice-born participate in this ritual stage?
premises: A method has been stated previously.
Consecration according to that method is a possible prior condition.
The participants in view are the best twice-born.
inference: Therefore the best twice-born may participate if they have previously been consecrated by the stated method.
